show.description: The Cursed Throne is a dark fantasy tale where Princess Kaelara, caught between duty and forbidden love, must fight against betrayal and ancient powers to reclaim her throne. As kingdoms clash and secrets unravel, she discovers that her greatest battle lies within her own heart.
